effect.minecraft.trial_omen.description: Transforms nearby trial spawners into ominous trial spawners. Last 15 minutes tiles the levels of the original Bad Omen effect
effect.minecraft.raid_omen.description: Starts a raid at the location the effect was gained, once the effect expires. Lasts 30 seconds.
effect.minecraft.wind_charged.descriptio: Makes affected entities emit a burst of wind on death.
effect.minecraft.weaving.description: Makes affected entities spread cobweb blocks upon death.
effect.minecraft.oozing.description: Makes affected entities spawn two slimes upon death.
effect.minecraft.infested.description: Gives affected entities a 10% chance to spawn between 1 and 2 silverfish when hurt.
effect.apothic_attributes.grievious.desc: Reduces healing received by 20% each level.
effect.apothic_attributes.vitality.descr: Increases healing received by 20% each level.
effect.deeperdarker.sculk_affinity.descr: Masks all sounds the player emits so Sculk Sensors can no longer pick them up. Does not mask sounds emitted by e.g. pets or dropped items!
effect.dungeons_mobs.ensnared.descriptio: Affected entities are trapped in place.
effect.dungeons_mobs.warped.description: Inflicts lethal magic damage over time.
effect.dungeons_gear.stunned.description: Stuns an entity, causing nausea and slowing their movement. Higher levels increase the stun chance.
effect.dungeons_gear.party_starter.descr: Melee attacks will cause entities to explode.
effect.dungeons_gear.dynamo.description: Increases damage on next attack, higher levels increase the damage boost.
effect.dungeons_gear.life_steal.descript: Steals health from entities killed, higher levels increase the amount of health stolen.
effect.dungeons_gear.bow_charge.descript: The next ranged attack will automatically be fully charged.
effect.farmersdelight.nourishment.descri: Prevents hunger loss, except when using saturation to heal damage.
effect.goodending.strong_immunity.descri: Strong immunity removes a harmful effect, then downgrades to contemporary immunity.
Contemporary immunity removes a harmful effect, then downgrades to shattered immunity.
effect.goodending.shattered_immunity.des: Shattered immunity removes a harmful effect, then dissipates.
effect.habitat.prickling,description: Has a chance to deal thorns damage equal to its level to the attacker.
effect.habitat.prolongation.description: Increases the duration of all incoming potion effects by 20%.
effect.species.wither_resistance.descrip: Grants immunity to the Wither effect.
effect.species.birtd.description: Stuns the afflicted and prevents them from moving, but not fighting back.
effect.mynethersdelight.b_pungent.descri: Deals fire damage when near a heat source.  Heals instead if you also have fire resistance.
effect.mynethersdelight.g_pungent.descri: Heals from heat sources when combined with fire resistance.  Deals damage instead without it.
effect.enigmaticlegacy.growing_hunger.de: Drains hunger over time,  but grants increased damage and life steal.
effect.enigmaticlegacy.growing_bloodlust: Drains health over time, but grants increased damage and life steal.  Only applied if the bearer of the curse has eaten the forbidden fruit.
effect.mowziesmobs.sunblock.description: The Umvuthana are protecting their chief!  Stop them before you're overwhelmed!
